from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DebtRepaymentRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's debt repayment cash outflow from their financial statement."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name as written in the document")
    document_id: str = Field(description="Which document this came from")
    cash_for_debt_repayment: float | None = Field(description="偿还债务支付的现金 amount for the period; None if not reported")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    currency: str = Field(default="元", description="Currency unit of the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    debt_repayments: list[DebtRepaymentRecord]
